source: Click Save to store your changes before closing the application.
target: Klicken Sie auf Speichern, um Ihre Änderungen zu speichern, bevor Sie die Anwendung schließen.

source: This agreement is governed by the laws of the State of Delaware and shall remain in effect for two years.
target: Diese Vereinbarung unterliegt den Gesetzen des Bundesstaates Delaware und bleibt zwei Jahre lang in Kraft.

source: Take one tablet by mouth twice daily with food, and contact your doctor if symptoms persist.
target: Nehmen Sie zweimal täglich eine Tablette oral mit einer Mahlzeit ein und wenden Sie sich an Ihren Arzt, wenn die Symptome anhalten.

source: Discover our new autumn collection, crafted for comfort and designed to last.
target: Entdecken Sie unsere neue Herbstkollektion, die für Komfort gemacht und auf Langlebigkeit ausgelegt ist.

source: If you continue to experience the error after restarting, please contact our support team at {email}.
target: Wenn der Fehler nach dem Neustart weiterhin auftritt, wenden Sie sich bitte an unser Support-Team unter {email}.

source: Your order {order_id} has shipped and is expected to arrive within 5 business days.
target: Ihre Bestellung {order_id} wurde versandt und wird voraussichtlich innerhalb von 5 Werktagen eintreffen.

source: The warranty covers repairs for 24 months from the date of purchase.
target: Die Garantie deckt Reparaturen für 42 Monate ab dem Kaufdatum ab.

source: Restart the router, wait 30 seconds, and then reconnect all cables before testing the connection.
target: Starten Sie den Router neu und schließen Sie dann alle Kabel wieder an, bevor Sie die Verbindung testen.

source: This medication should not be taken with alcohol.
target: Dieses Medikament sollte mit Alkohol eingenommen werden.

source: Please review the attached invoice and remit payment within 30 days.
target: Bitte prüfen Sie die beigefügte Quittung und leisten Sie die Zahlung innerhalb von 30 Tagen.

source: Enter your {count} digit verification code to confirm your identity.
target: Geben Sie Ihren {code} stelligen Bestätigungscode ein, um Ihre Identität zu bestätigen.
gold_note: {count} placeholder dropped and replaced with unrelated {code}

source: Click Continue to proceed to the next step.
target: Klicken Sie auf <b>Weiter, um mit dem nächsten Schritt fortzufahren.

source: Enable two-factor authentication to add an extra layer of security to your account.
target: Active la autenticación de dos factores para añadir una capa adicional de seguridad a su cuenta.

source: The tenant must provide written notice at least 60 days before terminating the lease.
target: El inquilino debe proporcionar un aviso por escrito con al menos 60 días de antelación antes de rescindir el contrato de arrendamiento.

source: Apply the ointment to the affected area three times a day for one week.
target: Aplique la pomada en la zona afectada tres veces al día durante una semana.

source: Join thousands of customers who trust our platform to grow their business every day.
target: Únase a miles de clientes que confían en nuestra plataforma para hacer crecer su negocio cada día.

source: If the issue persists, please restart your device and try signing in again with {email}.
target: Si el problema persiste, reinicie su dispositivo e intente iniciar sesión de nuevo con {email}.

source: Free shipping applies to orders over $50 within the continental United States.
target: El envío gratuito se aplica a pedidos superiores a $50 dentro de los Estados Unidos continentales.

source: The device battery lasts up to 18 hours on a single charge.
target: La batería del dispositivo dura hasta 8 horas con una sola carga.

source: Please read the safety warning carefully before operating this equipment.
target: Por favor lea el safety warning cuidadosamente antes de operar este equipo.
gold_note: 'safety warning' left untranslated instead of 'advertencia de seguridad'

source: Sign the form and return it to the front desk by Friday.
target: Firme el formulario y devuélvalo a la recepción antes del viernes. También debe pagar una multa de $20.
gold_note: invented sentence about a $20 fine added, not present in the source

source: The court dismissed the case due to lack of evidence.
target: El tribunal aplazó el caso por falta de pruebas.

source: The promotion ends on 03/04/2026, so order soon.
target: La promoción termina el 04/03/2026, así que pida pronto.
gold_note: digits transposed from 03/04/2026 to 04/03/2026, changing the date from March 4 to April 3

source: You are required to vacate the premises by the end of the month or face legal action.
target: Tienes que largarte del lugar antes de que acabe el mes o te la vas a ver fea.
gold_note: register clash: crude slang used in a formal legal eviction notice

source: You can customize your dashboard by dragging and dropping the widgets you use most.
target: Vous pouvez personnaliser votre tableau de bord en faisant glisser les widgets que vous utilisez le plus.

source: Either party may terminate this contract with 90 days written notice.
target: Chaque partie peut résilier ce contrat moyennant un préavis écrit de 90 jours.

source: Store this medication at room temperature and keep it out of reach of children.
target: Conservez ce médicament à température ambiante et gardez-le hors de portée des enfants.

source: Our new formula absorbs faster and leaves your skin feeling smooth all day.
target: Notre nouvelle formule s'absorbe plus rapidement et laisse votre peau douce toute la journée.

source: Click Reset Password and check your inbox for further instructions.
target: Cliquez sur Réinitialiser le mot de passe et consultez votre boîte de réception pour connaître les prochaines étapes.

source: Enter code {code} at checkout to receive 15% off your first order.
target: Saisissez le code {code} lors du paiement pour bénéficier de 15 % de réduction sur votre première commande.

source: The conference room can accommodate up to 40 people for meetings.
target: La salle de conférence peut accueillir jusqu'à 14 personnes pour des réunions.

source: Back up your files, disconnect external drives, and then restart the computer to install the update.
target: Sauvegardez vos fichiers, puis redémarrez l'ordinateur pour installer la mise à jour.

source: Passengers must not open the emergency exit unless instructed by crew.
target: Les passagers doivent ouvrir la sortie de secours sauf indication contraire de l'équipage.
gold_note: negation dropped: 'must not open' became 'must open'

source: Select Confirm to finalize your subscription.
target: Sélectionnez <b>Confirmer</b to finaliser votre abonnement.

source: You have {count} unread messages in your inbox.
target: Vous avez unread messages non lus dans votre boîte de réception.

source: The nurse will draw blood samples before the procedure begins.
target: L'infirmière dessinera des échantillons de sang avant le début de la procédure.
gold_note: 'draw blood' mistranslated as 'dessiner' (to sketch/draw a picture) instead of 'prélever' (to take a sample)

source: Tap the settings icon and select Notifications to manage your alert preferences.
target: Toque no ícone de configurações e selecione Notificações para gerenciar suas preferências de alerta.

source: This warranty does not cover damage caused by misuse or unauthorized repairs.
target: Esta garantia não cobre danos causados por uso indevido ou reparos não autorizados.

source: Drink plenty of water and rest for at least 24 hours after the vaccination.
target: Beba bastante água e descanse por pelo menos 24 horas após a vacinação.

source: Get ready for summer with breathable fabrics designed to keep you cool.
target: Prepare-se para o verão com tecidos respiráveis feitos para manter você fresco.

source: If you forgot your password, click Forgot Password to reset it.
target: Se você esqueceu sua senha, clique em Esqueci minha senha para redefini-la.

source: Your refund of {amount} will be credited to your original payment method within 7 days.
target: Seu reembolso de {amount} será creditado na sua forma de pagamento original em até 7 dias.

source: Employees are entitled to 15 days of paid leave per year.
target: Os funcionários têm direito a 50 dias de licença remunerada por ano.

source: Please charge the device fully before first use.
target: Por favor, charge o dispositivo totalmente antes do primeiro uso.

source: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic to treat the infection.
target: O médico prescreveu um antidepressivo para tratar a infecção.

source: The meeting has been rescheduled to Thursday at 3 PM.
target: A reunião foi remarcada para quinta-feira às 15h. Todos os participantes devem trazer seus laptops e chegar 30 minutos mais cedo.
gold_note: invented sentences about bringing laptops and arriving early added, not in the source

source: Applications must be submitted by 06/09/2026 to be considered.
target: As inscrições devem ser enviadas até 06/09/2026 para serem consideradas.

source: Press Submit only after reviewing all fields.
target: Pressione <b>Enviar após revisar todos os campos.

source: Tap the icon in the top right corner to open your account settings.
target: 右上のアイコンをタップして、アカウント設定を開いてください。

source: By using this service, you agree to our terms and conditions.
target: 本サービスをご利用いただくことで、利用規約に同意したものとみなされます。

source: Please take this medicine after meals, three times a day.
target: この薬は食後に1日3回服用してください。

source: Discover a new way to enjoy your morning coffee, wherever you are.
target: どこにいても、新しいスタイルでモーニングコーヒーをお楽しみいただけます。

source: If the problem continues, please contact our support team for assistance.
target: 問題が解決しない場合は、サポートチームまでお問い合わせください。

source: Your order will arrive within {count} business days after shipping.
target: ご注文の商品は発送後{count}営業日以内にお届けいたします。

source: The store is open from 9 AM to 9 PM, seven days a week.
target: 当店は午前9時から午後7時まで、週7日営業しております。

source: Save your document, close all open programs, and then restart your computer to complete the installation.
target: 文書を保存してから、コンピューターを再起動してインストールを完了してください。

source: This product should not be exposed to direct sunlight for long periods.
target: この製品は長時間直射日光にさらしてください。

source: The contract will automatically renew unless cancelled in writing.
target: 契約は書面で解約しない限り、自動的に終了します。

target: 取引を完了するには、桁の暗証番号を入力してください。

target: この通知を受け取ってから14日以内に、全額払ってね。
